themes_detail.label: Emergency Response Team Surge
themes_detail.summary: Emergency Response Team complaints spiked to 4 this week versus a baseline average of 0.4 per week—a 967% increase (z-score: 7.49)—suggesting a sudden public safety or quality-of-life incident requiring immediate investigation into what triggered this unprecedented spike.
evidence: 4 ERT complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No recent local news mentions, suggesting under-reported story
reporting_angles: What specific incident or pattern triggered ERT deployment this week? Interview NYPD/ERT commanders.
Map ERT complaint locations to identify concentration—is this neighborhood-wide or block-specific?

themes_detail.label: Noise Complaints Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints jumped to 25 this week versus an 8-week average of 11.4 per week—a 120% increase (z-score: 4.37)—with a parallel spike in house of worship noise (3 complaints last week vs. 0.4 baseline, 700% increase), indicating potential event-related or construction-related disruption.
evidence: 25 general noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 11.4 weekly average (120% spike, z-score: 4.37)
3 house of worship noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 5.42)
2,136 total noise complaints over 90 days shows chronic issue, but this week is acute acceleration
reporting_angles: Is the spike tied to a specific venue, construction project, or community event? Cross-reference DOB permits (301 filed in 90 days).
Are religious institutions receiving complaints related to services, amplified events, or renovation work?

themes_detail.label: Street Vendor Enforcement Spike
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints surged to 4 this week versus a baseline of 0.5 per week—a 700% increase (z-score: 7.0)—suggesting either a concentrated street vending operation or coordinated enforcement action worth documenting.
evidence: 4 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 7.0)

No prior local news coverage indicates emerging or under-reported enforcement activity
reporting_angles: Is NYPD/DOC conducting a targeted street vending sweep this week? Request enforcement data.
Which corridors or neighborhoods are seeing increased enforcement? Map complaint locations.

themes_detail.label: Sidewalk Deterioration Trend

evidence: 11 sidewalk condition complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 4.5 weekly average (144% spike, z-score: 2.98)

reporting_angles: Are alterations and new construction projects causing sidewalk damage? Cross-reference DOB filings with complaint locations.
